# Aditya Rajbhar

> Aditya Rajbhar (handle: codebyaadi) is a software engineer from India. He
> builds full-stack web applications and backend systems across the TypeScript,
> Go and Python stacks. This is his personal site and portfolio.

From 2024 to 2026 Aditya was a Software Developer at Landmark Aquatec, where he
built the web platform for the company's water- and sewage-treatment products:
real-time IoT dashboards over live plant telemetry (sensors, pumps, valves),
backed by FastAPI services on Google Cloud with Firestore and a React / Next.js
front end. He also builds open-source projects and writes about software, and is
open to new roles and projects.

## Focus areas

- Full-stack web development — React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL
- Backend and distributed systems — Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka
- Cloud and infrastructure — Google Cloud, AWS, Docker, Turborepo, Bun
- AI-assisted tooling — OpenAI API, Google Gemini, retrieval-augmented generation

## Selected projects

- [Upzy](https://github.com/codebyaadi/upzy): Uptime and performance monitoring
  platform. Turborepo monorepo with a Next.js dashboard and NestJS services,
  PostgreSQL via Drizzle, Better Auth; designed for a microservices-first
  architecture.
- [Keel](https://github.com/codebyaadi/keel): SaaS starter kit / backbone.
  Bun + Turborepo monorepo with an ElysiaJS API, Next.js app, Prisma 8,
  Better Auth (organisations + admin), React Email, and a validated environment.
- [Feedoku](https://github.com/codebyaadi/feedoku): High-performance RSS feed
  aggregator. Go API, Next.js reader, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka.
- [Vitube](https://vitube-streaming-platform.vercel.app/): Video streaming and
  sharing platform on the MERN stack with Cloudinary media handling.
